headline: Windsor Machines files 63rd AGM e-voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine AGM resolutions pass at Windsor Machines
summary: Windsor Machines Limited has submitted the e-voting results and consolidated scrutinizer report for its 63rd Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. All resolutions proposed at the meeting were placed before shareholders for voting. Routine annual compliance filings like this have no material impact on the company's financial position or stock price. Indian retail shareholders can note the completion of corporate governance formalities for the year.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on your portfolio.
